name: Cuban-Spiced Steak with Garlicky Avocado, Tomato & Onion Salad
ingredients: 1 ½ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice the citrus into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the citrus juice along with oil and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat; set aside to marinate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
While the steak is cooking, cut tomatoes into wedges and add to the bowl with the onions.
Halve and pit the avocados. Scoop halves out with a spoon and cut into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak between plates; use a slotted spoon to portion salad, then drizzle steak with leftover dressing. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
